text: You saw the sea split for you... would you ever bow to a statue? They did.
Prophet Musa, alayhis salaam, went to meet his Lord for forty nights.
And Allah told him: We have tried your people after you, and the Samiri has led them astray.
The Samiri brought out for them a calf, a body with a lowing sound. And they said: This is your god, and the god of Musa, but he forgot.
Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech, and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?
Prophet Harun, alayhis salaam, had told them: O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed your Lord is the Most Merciful.
So Musa, alayhis salaam, returned to his people, angry and grieved. And he asked: What is your case, O Samiri?
He said: I saw what they did not see... and thus did my soul entice me.
Musa said: Look at your god to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it, and blow it into the sea with a blast.
A god that cannot answer you, cannot harm you, cannot help you... is not a god. Turn to the One who answers.
